params.shape: A Shape object or an array of them.
params.options:
Extrusion options (dictionary)
- curveSegments: number of segments on curves
- steps: number of extrusion steps
- depth: extrusion depth
- bevelEnabled: whether to apply a bevel
- bevelThickness: bevel thickness
- bevelSize: bevel size
- bevelOffset: bevel offset
- bevelSegments: number of bevel segments
